proof_semantics.source_hash: Proves the intended baseline specification; DOES NOT prove remote cloud execution attestation.
proof_semantics.hmac_seal: Proves the client has not tampered with the turn topology; DOES NOT prove the server is trustless.
proof_semantics.model_identifier: Proves the specific API request payload target; DOES NOT prove provider internal execution mechanics.
proof_semantics.on_chain_archive_commitment: Proves the absolute immutable baseline hash for local purchaser verification.
proof_semantics.single_use_nonce: Proves protection against EIP-1193 signature replay attacks.
